scripts.test: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo/ctx-monorepo/$(basename "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)")} cargo test -q && pnpm -C apps/web test
scripts.test:agent: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo/ctx-monorepo/$(basename "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)")} cargo test -q -p ctx-core -p ctx-providers -p ctx-http -p ctx-mcp -p ctx-lsp && pnpm -C apps/web test:quiet
scripts.desktop:prep: node scripts/desktop_check_versions.cjs && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo/ctx-monorepo/$(basename "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)")} cargo build -p ctx-http -p ctx-mcp && pnpm -C apps/web build && node scripts/desktop_sync_resources.cjs --profile debug
scripts.desktop:prep:release: node scripts/desktop_check_versions.cjs && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo/ctx-monorepo/$(basename "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)")} cargo build -p ctx-http -p ctx-mcp --release && pnpm -C apps/web build && node scripts/desktop_sync_resources.cjs --profile release
scripts.native:check:automation: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo/ctx-monorepo/$(basename "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)")} RUSTFLAGS=-Dwarnings cargo check --manifest-path apps/native/Cargo.toml --all-targets --features automation
scripts.native:test:automation: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/cargo/ctx-monorepo/$(basename "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)")} RUSTFLAGS=-Dwarnings cargo test --manifest-path apps/native/Cargo.toml --features automation -q
scripts.ios-native:build: bash -lc 'if [ "$(uname -s)" != "Darwin" ]; then echo "ios-native: skipped (not macOS)"; exit 0; fi; command -v xcodegen >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "error: xcodegen not found (brew install xcodegen)" >&2; exit 1; }; command -v xcodebuild >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "error: xcodebuild not found" >&2; exit 1; }; cd apps/ios-native; xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null; derived="${XCODE_DERIVED_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/xcode/ctx-ios-native/$(basename "$(git rev-parse --git-dir)")}"; mkdir -p "$derived"; xcodebuild -project CtxIOS.xcodeproj -scheme CtxIOS -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "generic/platform=iOS Simulator" -derivedDataPath "$derived" build -quiet'
scripts.supabase:migrations:check: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const path=require("path"); const dir=path.join(process.cwd(),"..","supabase","migrations"); if(!fs.existsSync(dir)) { console.error("error: missing supabase/migrations"); process.exit(1); } const files=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((f)=>f.endsWith(".sql")).sort(); if(files.length===0) { console.error("error: no supabase migrations found"); process.exit(1); } const seen=new Set(); for(const f of files){ if(seen.has(f)) { console.error("error: duplicate migration "+f); process.exit(1);} seen.add(f); if(!/^\d{14}_.+\.sql$/.test(f)) { console.error("error: bad migration filename "+f+" (expected YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_name.sql)"); process.exit(1);} } console.log("supabase migrations ok ("+files.length+")");'
scripts.supabase:functions:check: bash -lc 'if ! command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "supabase functions: skipped (deno not installed)"; exit 0; fi; deno check --quiet ../supabase/functions/*/index.ts'
scripts.verify:quick: turbo run rust:fmt rust:clippy rust:test native:check native:check:automation native:test ios-native:build supabase:migrations:check supabase:functions:check --filter=ctx-monorepo --cache-dir=${TURBO_CACHE_DIR:-$HOME/.cache/turbo/ctx-monorepo} --output-logs=errors-only --concurrency=1
